provenance.scope: ordinary SQL, exact aggregates, fully consumed Arrow; matched internal worker/budget settings recorded by the actual run
provenance.timing_claim: Full-scale comparison, conditional on verified backup/restore window; no full-scale result exists before execution.
provenance.note: Both immutable archives cross-built in the same constrained local Linux amd64 image, four CPU/8GiB, using the same compiler and flags; runtime resources/topology are recorded by the actual comparison.

scope_notes: All three trials included; no discarded warmups or best-of selection.
Connection/setup excluded from query elapsed; complete Arrow fetch included.
CPU is per-process CPU; server INFO includes monitor/control and cluster traffic.
Worker-duration counters overlap and must not be summed into elapsed time.
Process RSS from getrusage; cgroup MemoryPeak can be unavailable after transient unit exit.
